test_cases.name: Happy path — feature đủ info, chạy 6 phase không bổ sung

input.context: Feature FEAT-EW-CRM-001 tồn tại trong registry. Spec đầy đủ, code đã implement. DB + BE chạy sẵn.

expected_behavior: Phase 0 SETUP: tạo session dir .mc-data/work/wf-e2e-verify/sessions/FEAT-EW-CRM-001-{YYYYMMDD-HHmm}/
Phase 1 BUSINESS: sinh 4 findings (business-understanding, business-rule-catalog, state-machine, cross-module-map). AskUserQuestion VERIFY blocking
Phase 2 DB: sinh 3 findings (db-mapping, db-seed-data ≥15 records, db-test-report). Live test pass constraint
Phase 3 API: sinh 2 findings (api-mapping, api-test-report). Live test happy + BR + state transition
Phase 4 UI: sinh 2 findings (ui-mapping, ui-test-report). Static analysis pass
Phase 5 INTEGRATION: sinh integration-test-report.md với 8 sections (cross-module LUÔN ON)
Phase 6 OUTPUT: sinh outputs/test-scenario.md (skeleton, ≥2 scenarios) + outputs/user-guide.md (Việt clear)
Tổng 12 finding/output files + 4 SSOT JSON (status, issues, block-test, implement-required, manual)

test_cases.name: Block classification — phát hiện Nhóm 3 + Nhóm 4 → DUAL-WRITE

input.context: Feature FEAT-EW-FIN-008 có 1 endpoint chưa implement (Nhóm 3) + 1 test cần VNPay sandbox (Nhóm 4 verified-OK). DB + BE chạy sẵn.

expected_behavior: Phase 3 API: detect endpoint chưa implement → DUAL-WRITE block-test.json (BLK-001, blocking_reason=feature_not_implemented) + implement-required.json (IMPL-REQ-001, status=pending, related_blk_id=BLK-001)

Phase 5 INTEGRATION: detect VNPay test cần con người → verify code (static review PASS) → DUAL-WRITE block-test.json (BLK-002, status=resolved, retest_result=SKIPPED) + manual.json (MAN-001, code_verification.result=PASS, related_blk_id=BLK-002)
Phase 6 OUTPUT: test-scenario.md có scenarios bị block đánh dấu 'BLOCKED (xem block-test.json BLK-001)' + 'MANUAL (xem manual.json MAN-001)'
assertions: jq '.blocked_tests[] | select(.related_impl_req_id)' block-test.json — link 2 chiều khớp

test_cases.name: Resume — tiếp Phase 3 sau P0-2 done

input.context: Session FEAT-EW-WMS-003-20260513-1000 đã hoàn tất P0-2. status.json.current_phase=3, sub_state=ASSESS. Phase 1 4 findings + Phase 2 3 findings đã có. issues.json có 2 entries.

expected_behavior: Skip Phase 0-2 (đã done)
Confirm phase_0/1/2_status='done' trong status.json (không re-run)
Run Phase 3 từ sub_state=ASSESS → BỔ SUNG (nếu cần) → LIVE-TEST → FIX (nếu --auto) → RETEST
Run Phase 4-6 sau Phase 3 hoàn tất
KHÔNG ghi đè findings/business-understanding.md (Phase 1) hoặc findings/db-*.md (Phase 2)
KHÔNG reset issues.json — APPEND issues mới phát hiện
assertions: Phase 0-2 files không thay đổi mtime
issues.json signals[] length >= 2 (không mất entries cũ)

test_cases.name: --status display + no execute

input.context: Session FEAT-EW-CRM-001-20260513-1100 đang chạy Phase 4, sub_state=BỔ SUNG. status.json + 4 SSOT JSON đã có.

expected_behavior: Đọc status.json + 4 SSOT JSON
Display dashboard 7-row table với phase status mỗi phase
Display SSOT counters: issues (open/fixed/total), block-test (blocked/resolved/unblocked), implement-required (pending/done), manual (pending/verified)
STOP — không advance phase
assertions: Không có file mới được tạo / sửa
Output text có chứa 'Phase Progress' table với 7 rows P0-P6
